_doc: מעדנייה + ירקות ופירות (fresh, deli meats/salads, frozen appetizers/veg/fruit). Deli meats live here rather than in meat-fish.json because they showed up mostly under מעדנייה in this dataset, but the regex matches products regardless of their own category field so it also lifts coverage in בשר ועוף. Canned/jarred חומוס (hummus) and טונה בשימורים belong to the pantry agent - skipped here even though a few leak into this category's word list.
